title: Debra K NDE 9579
content: On February 26, 2023, at 3:30 a.m. I went into V-fib cardiac arrest and died. The doctors used the defibrillator paddles to bring me back to life. All day that Saturday, I had what I thought was heart burn. So, I was taking Tums antacids all day long. I went to sleep, but woke up at 3 in the morning. I thought I was having a gall bladder attack. I called 911, and told them don’t put on lights and sirens because I would meet them downstairs. I then walked down 4 flights of stairs. The ambulance arrived and they hooked me up to various machines. They told me it was my heart and that I had an hour. They rushed me to the hospital where I was greeted by about 15 doctors, nurses, and other medical staff. They put all sorts of needles in my both my arm veins and I felt myself falling asleep. Ten minutes after arrival, my heart went into V-fib. The next thing I know I hear my name being screamed. I opened my eyes and the doctor asked me if I saw the light? He told me that I had died and that they had to paddle me back to life when my heart stopped. I then told him what happened. It was like a Peter Max poster. I saw the most vividly beautiful, psychedelic colors that I had ever seen in my life. I felt peace like I have never felt before and it was actually beautiful. I also told him that I was annoyed they brought me back. Later, another cardiologist went in through groin to put in a balloon and a stent in my lower heart chamber to remove a blockage. All I kept hearing the next two days was that I shouldn’t be alive. If I didn’t call an ambulance exactly at the time I did, I wouldn’t be alive. I quit smoking the night it happened. The weird part is that when they paddled me, the doctor said it rewired my brain. This body doesn’t think it ever smoked, so I never went through any withdrawals or cravings. I now have no fear of death despite having had panic attacks about death my whole life. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: February 26, 2023 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Heart attack CPR given. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) I went into v-fib cardiac arrest How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. Everything was clear, bright, beautiful, and unreal. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? The whole time Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I have 20/20 now, yet my eyes have never seen colors like I saw during my experience. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I did not hear anything Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes There were bright colors I've never seen on earth. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I was surrounded by bright, beautiful colors What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt peace and love Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? No comment Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I now wear religious metals - a cross, a star of all religions and beliefs etc What is your religion now? No comment Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I was always afraid of death. I never thought I would go somewhere and see and feel what I did after I died. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I now believe in life after death. There is another realm or dimension after we die. I now believe materialistic things are not important Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes There is universal connection and oneness in a mystical, colorful place During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes. I feel I have been to the other side. I know what dying feels like. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I was definitely in another realm Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes. I felt love and peace on the other side. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I feel more at peace. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I remember what happened as if it just happened and think about it everyday. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I sometimes know what's going to happen. I often dream of strangers first and last names. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? all Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared immediately. I didn't care if they believed me or not Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I felt immediately that my experience was real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. My experience is real because it happened to me. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I am blessed to have had this experience and to come back and let people know. The best advice I can give is to let people know not to be AFRAID of death.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as "like a Peter Max poster" with "vividly beautiful, psychedelic colors" and being "surrounded by bright, beautiful colors" in a "clearly mystical or unearthly realm."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: V-fib cardiac arrest/heart attack; defibrillation used to revive.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reported vivid psychedelic colors and a mystical light; no tunnel, no beings, no life review, no boundary.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE reported without described vantage; directly followed by immersion in mystical light/colors/realm; then abrupt return with hearing her name screamed and awakening to doctor.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Visual field described as "like a Peter Max poster" with "vividly beautiful, psychedelic colors"; reported being "annoyed they brought me back"; post-event claim that defibrillation "rewired my brain" leading to immediate smoking cessation without cravings/withdrawals; dreams of strangers' first and last names.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It was like a Peter Max poster." "I saw the most vividly beautiful, psychedelic colors that I had ever seen in my life." "I felt peace like I have never felt before." "I was annoyed they brought me back." "This body doesn’t think it ever smoked." "The best advice I can give is to let people know not to be AFRAID of death."
